correctness.rationale: The order-5 exclusion follows from the unique D10 maximal subgroup containing a given C5. All remaining adjacency types are reduced to the known subgroup types V4, S3, D10 and A4; explicit minimal triples witness every extendable pair type. The projective fixed-point description gives the 3-cycle induced graph and all degree counts. The packaged exhaustive permutation checker independently scans all 59 choose 3 nonidentity triples, obtaining 1240 minimal generating triples, 35 vertices, 405 edges, the stated degree sequence and diameter 2.

value.rationale: The primary source explicitly leaves fixed-size connectivity beyond soluble groups open. A5 is the smallest unsoluble finite group, so its complete size-three layer is the first natural boundary case. The result is more than a yes/no computation: it gives every vertex, every adjacency type, a recognizable T(5) blow-up, exact degree classes, edge count and diameter, providing a concrete model for how fixed-size independence graphs behave once solubility is lost.
